summary.zh: 罗马尼亚城市搜索与救援队（RO-USAR01）于2026年10月19日至23日在罗马尼亚完成 INSARAG 分级认证，由中型队晋升为重型队。

content.en:
The Romanian USAR Team (RO-USAR01) has successfully achieved reclassification from Medium to Heavy following the INSARAG classification process held in Romania from 19 to 23 October 2026.
The INSARAG Secretariat extends its warmest congratulations to the Romanian Team on this important achievement and commends its dedication, professionalism, and commitment to international urban search and rescue. The Secretariat also expresses its sincere appreciation to all classifiers for their valuable contributions throughout the process.
content.zh:
罗马尼亚城市搜索与救援队（RO-USAR01）于2026年10月19日至23日在罗马尼亚境内完成 INSARAG 分级认证程序，成功由中型队晋升为重型队。
INSARAG 秘书处向罗马尼亚队伍致以最热烈的祝贺，赞扬其在国际城市搜救领域所展现的奉献精神、专业素养与坚定承诺。秘书处同时向全体认证评估员在整个过程中所作出的宝贵贡献表示诚挚谢意。
